2608.02347.title: Mamba with Hierarchical Memory: Solving Representation Bottleneck in Long Sequence Modeling
2608.02347.paper_summary: Recurrent linear attention models (RLAs) such as Mamba offer efficient linear-time sequence modeling as an alternative to Transformers, yet their fixed-capacity recurrent states limit long-sequence modeling. Drawing inspiration from hierarchical human memory, we propose Hierarchical Memory Mamba (HMM) to address this limitation. Building upon a pre-trained Mamba backbone, HMM integrates a lightweight working memory that extracts slow paragraph-level semantics (PLS) from the fast sensory memory embedded in the backbone's hidden states. The PLS is subsequently compressed into persistent long-term memory for task-relevant retrieval. The hierarchical processing of semantic information overcomes the representation bottleneck of RLAs and endows HMM cross-task generalization through parametric learning, which is not observed in other long-context enhanced Mamba variants. Evaluations on Passkey Retrieval and LongBench-E tasks demonstrate that HMM improves retrieval success by 34.3--37.1% and reasoning accuracy by 1.6--14.2% over strong Mamba-based models, while adding only 2% extra parameters and with minimal training overhead.
2608.02347.paper_summary_zh: 重複線性注意力模型（RLA）如 Mamba 提供了高效的線性時間序列建模作為 Transformers 的替代方案，但其固定容量的重複狀態限制了長序列建模。受到層次性人類記憶的啟發，我們提出了層次記憶 Mamba（HMM）來解決這一限制。在預訓練的 Mamba 主幹上，HMM 整合了一個輕量級的工作記憶，從嵌入在主幹隱藏狀態中的快速感官記憶中提取緩慢的段落級語義（PLS）。隨後，PLS 被壓縮成持久的長期記憶，以便於與任務相關的檢索。語義信息的層次處理克服了 RLA 的表示瓶頸，並通過參數學習賦予 HMM 跨任務的泛化能力，而這在其他增強長上下文的 Mamba 變體中並未觀察到。在 Passkey Retrieval 和 LongBench-E 任務上的評估顯示，HMM 在檢索成功率上提高了 34.3--37.1%，在推理準確性上提高了 1.6--14.2%，相比於強大的基於 Mamba 的模型，同時僅增加了 2% 的額外參數，並且訓練開銷最小。
